prompt_text:
Match this appearance phrase against ALL anonymous person tiles in the image(s): "the person with long dark hair wearing a white turtleneck crop top and white loose-fitting pants"
Every labeled tile is one different person from the same video; its two crops are held-out views. Labels and tile order do not reveal the intended target. A phrase may match none, one, or several people. Include ALL people who visibly satisfy the whole phrase in matches. Include in uncertain any plausible person for whom the views do not resolve an attribute, instead of assuming that person is a non-match. Do not pick a best match when several fit. A location or action does not distinguish appearance. Omitted labels mean clear non-matches.
Return {"matches":["P01"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"brief visual explanation"}. Valid labels: ["P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P08"].

message.content: {"matches":["P01","P02","P03","P05","P08"],"uncertain":["P06"],"reason":"P01, P02, P03, P05, and P08 all show long dark hair and are wearing white turtleneck crop tops with white loose-fitting pants. P06 has long hair but appears to have lighter, possibly two-toned hair, and the top is less clearly a turtleneck; the fit of the pants is also less certain. P04 has blonde hair, P07 wears shorts, so they are clear non-matches."}
